_description: Shape of the JSON string inside event.Records[0].Sns.Message when the review Lambda is invoked via its SNS subscription to a CloudWatch alarm's AlarmActions. Only NewStateValue == 'ALARM' should trigger the pipeline; 'OK' transitions arrive too and should be ignored (see lambda/handler.py).
NewStateReason: Thresholds Crossed: 2 out of the last 2 datapoints were greater than the upper thresholds of the band. The most recent datapoint [4.2] was greater than the upper threshold [1.1] within 60 seconds.
